source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Unmanned aerial image dataset: Ready for 3D reconstruction. Data in Brief 25, 103962. DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Triangle-plane intersection against the binned observed-cell TLS surface mesh preview.
processing.sourceGapPolicy: Contours are emitted only where the TLS surface mesh has faces. The source mesh fills small enclosed interior display gaps but does not extend outside the observed TLS footprint.

reviewStatus.notes: This is legibility linework for the TLS mesh preview, not a final surveyed contour product.
